message_id.description: The msg_... id you reply to; take it from mailbox. Example: msg_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001

text.description: Your reply. Example: Done, see the PR.

data.description: Optional structured data, a JSON object. Example: {"pr": 12}.

files.description: Up to 5 fil_... ids from file_put. Example: ["fil_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"].
